about.title: Russian manufacturer of security systems
about.subtitle: Full cycle of development, production and service of inspection equipment. Operating since 2010.

history.title: Our history
history.p1: The company was founded in 2010 by a group of engineers united by the idea of creating domestic inspection equipment that matches global counterparts in accuracy and reliability.
history.p2: Over 15 years, we've grown from a small laboratory into a full-fledged manufacturing enterprise with our own design bureau, testing center, and service network across Russia.
history.p3: Today our equipment operates in airports, railway stations, industrial complexes, and government facilities throughout the country.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.p1: We make complex technologies accessible for ensuring the safety of people and infrastructure. Our goal is for every facility that needs it to be equipped with modern inspection systems.
mission.p2: We believe security should not be a compromise between quality, price, and convenience. That's why we develop equipment that solves all three tasks at once.

values.title: Our values
values.subtitle: The principles we follow every day.
values.accuracyText: Engineering approach and quality control at every stage of production.
values.reliabilityText: Equipment operates in the most demanding conditions.
values.innovationText: In-house research in radar and signal processing.
values.partnershipText: Long-term relationships with clients and full service after delivery.

production.title: In-house full-cycle production
production.subtitle: All key components — radiation generators, detectors, signal processing systems, and software — are developed and manufactured at our facility.
